testCases.title: Create Team (Happy Path)
steps: Assign at least one team role
expectedResults: Team record created with name='Test Team Gamma', isActive=true
A UAM Team Role row is created linking the team to a group
cleanup: Soft-delete the created team and its team roles

testCases.title: Map team to organization
steps: Use the org-team mapping to add 'Test Team Gamma'
expectedResults: A UAM Organization Team row links the org and team
The team appears under the org's teams view

testCases.title: Assign and remove team application roles
steps: Associate the application and select roles via the editable role grid
Then remove one role and submit
expectedResults: Selected application roles are mapped to the team, then the removed role is de-mapped
assertions: Team Role rows reflect the added then removed application roles
cleanup: Remove any remaining test role mappings
